steps.name: Audit bounded RV64 external theorem closures
Package checked RV64 Lean export sources
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
python3 - <<'PYEXPORT'
import hashlib, json, os, pathlib, tarfile
root = pathlib.Path("external/sail-riscv/build/model/Lean_RV64D")
out = pathlib.Path(os.environ["RUNNER_TEMP"]) / "rv64-sail-export"
out.mkdir()
required = {"lakefile.toml", "lake-manifest.json", "lean-toolchain"}
for name in required:
    assert (root / name).is_file(), f"Missing export input: {name}"
toolchain = (root / "lean-toolchain").read_text().strip()
assert toolchain == "leanprover/lean4:v4.29.0", toolchain
lock = json.loads((root / "lake-manifest.json").read_text())
sail = next(p for p in lock["packages"] if p["name"] == "Sail")
assert sail["rev"] == "079463134b9c50450b8393e1566a09fc492a34d9", sail
assert sail["url"].rstrip("/").removesuffix(".git") == "https://github.com/rems-project/lean-sail", sail
files = sorted(p for p in root.rglob("*") if p.is_file()
               and not p.is_symlink()
               and not any(x.startswith(".") for x in p.relative_to(root).parts)
               and (p.suffix == ".lean" or p.relative_to(root).as_posix() in required))
assert any(p.suffix == ".lean" for p in files), "No generated Lean sources"
hashes = []
archive = out / "Lean_RV64D.sources.tar.gz"
with tarfile.open(archive, "w:gz") as tar:
    for path in files:
        name = "Lean_RV64D/" + path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
        hashes.append(hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() + "  " + name)
        tar.add(path, arcname=name, recursive=False)
(out / "FILES.sha256").write_text("\n".join(hashes) + "\n")
provenance = {
    "oak_commit": os.environ["GITHUB_SHA"],
    "workflow_run_id": os.environ["GITHUB_RUN_ID"],
    "workflow_run_attempt": os.environ["GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"],
    "sail_commit": os.environ["SAIL_GIT_COMMIT"],
    "sail_riscv_commit": os.environ["SAIL_RISCV_COMMIT"],
    "lean_sail_commit": sail["rev"],
    "lean_toolchain": toolchain,
    "contents": "Generated Lean sources and locked Lake build inputs; no caches",
}
(out / "PROVENANCE.json").write_text(json.dumps(provenance, indent=2) + "\n")
(out / "SHA256SUMS").write_text("".join(
    hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() + "  " + p.name + "\n"
    for p in sorted(out.iterdir()) if p.is_file()))
PYEXPORT
